audit_title: QuantEngine Phase 173 Independent Audit, Queue Model Validation & Post-Cost Result Reproduction Findings

findings.summary: Phase 172 release candidate independently verified against detached record and manifest
findings.description: QuantEngine_PHASE172_RELEASE_CANDIDATE.zip (56,809,944 bytes, SHA-256 67d3e60e88f21c7c53fd5c0d0b5fbfc7f789df65099fe9636c2b6ffc8d33571c) verified byte-for-byte against RELEASE_HASH_PHASE172.txt. All 2,077 ZIP members (2,076 manifest entries + BUILD_MANIFEST.sha256) checked with zero path traversals, zero duplicate members, and zero hash mismatches.
findings.mitigation: Baseline integrity certified prior to downstream quantitative analysis.

findings.summary: All six setup rows reproduced; 150-pt setup P&L difference mathematically derived
findings.description: Recalculated Micro-Scalp (4.5), Tight Scalp (15), Small Intraday (50), Standard Intraday (150), Swing (400), and Wide Trend (1000) setups to 8 decimal places. Proved that on the 150-pt setup, Conservative Maker (+0.0519 USD) underperforms Taker (+0.0532 USD) because adverse selection (0.0164 USD) and non-fill opportunity cost (0.0138 USD) total 0.0302 USD, exceeding the 0.0290 USD entry commission saving.
findings.mitigation: Enforce explicit fee, adverse selection, and opportunity cost modeling in strategy evaluation.

findings.summary: Poisson queue fill probabilities formally proven as exponential block-waiting model assumptions
findings.description: Audited queue dynamics formula 1 - exp(-lambda*t/Q) producing P(any) = 86.47% and P(complete) = 86.20% for 100 contracts ahead, 20 contracts/sec, 10s horizon. Proved that this formula represents the CDF of a single exponential waiting-time block, whereas a unit Poisson process (Erlang-100) would yield > 99.9999% probability. Confirmed and retained classification as SIMULATION_ASSUMPTION.
findings.mitigation: Forbid presenting uncalibrated Poisson arrival calculations as observed empirical venue fill probabilities.

findings.summary: Mathematical rule hierarchy established: Rule 1 strictly subsumes Rule 2
findings.description: Demonstrated that Rule 2 (Target >= 2.0 * Breakeven) is mathematically equivalent to Fees / Target <= 50.0%. Because Rule 1 requires Fees / Target <= 40.0%, Rule 1 is strictly stricter than Rule 2. Any trade violating Rule 2 will always fail Rule 1 first. Rule 3 (Post-Fee R:R >= 1.25) acts as the active binding gate for mid-range intraday targets.
findings.mitigation: Track multi-rule rejections in TradeSelectionTally to prevent erroneous double-counting.

findings.summary: Historical datasets verified as temporally disjoint; multi-year tick depth confirmed blocked
findings.description: Verified that data/history/BTCUSDT/1m.parquet (1,440 continuous rows from 2026-09-05/06) and research/captures/phase167_recon/l2/delta_ob_updates_archive.json (113 frames from 2026-10-19) represent completely disjoint observation windows. Multi-year (2024-2026) continuous tick depth remains unsupplied and retained as BLOCKED_EVIDENCE (BLOCK-172-05).
findings.mitigation: Require ingestion of raw tick/depth datasets before claiming empirical backtest validation.
